description: This file contains unit test fixtures and mock setup code for testing the ServerManagerModuleService component in a Rialto media server project. It defines mock expectations, helper functions, and test setup routines to verify the behavior of server configuration, state management, ping handling, and logging within the server module.

classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up mocks and helper methods to test ServerManagerModuleService functionalities.
